meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速制作并渲染视频动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要批量生成视频内容
copy.tagline_en: Create and render video animations quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate video content in batches

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 hyperframes 命令制作动画视频:新建项目、搜索现成动作、编写画面、检查、预览,最后渲染成视频。也会用它诊断构建/渲染失败。渲染可发生在本地、HeyGen 云端、AWS Lambda 或 Google Cloud Run 上。
howto.when: 当你想做或改 HyperFrames 动画视频(如新建项目、预览、渲染),遇到构建或渲染报错,或要求用云端、AWS Lambda 或 Cloud Run 渲染时,Claude 会用这套 CLI 处理。

say.text: 做一个标题逐行出现的动画视频
say.note: 先在本地动作库里找现成的,没有才手写。

say.text: 检查一下我刚做的 HyperFrames 项目
say.note: 会运行 lint 与 check,报告有无问题。

say.text: 用云端渲染这个项目,输出 mp4
say.note: 会调用 cloud render,无需本地渲染环境。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude uses the hyperframes CLI to make animated videos: scaffold, search catalog, author, lint/check, preview, render. It also diagnoses build/render failures. Rendering can run locally, on HeyGen cloud, AWS Lambda, or Google Cloud Run.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to make or edit a HyperFrames animated video (e.g., scaffold, preview, render), when build/render fails, or when cloud, Lambda, or Cloud Run rendering is requested.

say_en.text: Create an animated video where a headline appears line by line.
say_en.note: Search catalog; hand-code only if no match.

say_en.text: Check my HyperFrames project for problems.
say_en.note: Runs lint and check; reports issues.

say_en.text: Render this project in the cloud and give me an mp4.
say_en.note: Uses cloud render; no local render needed.
